common.fallback: Button not working? Copy and paste this link into your browser:
common.ignore: Didn't request this? You can safely ignore it.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.preview: Reset your Harly password — this link expires in 1 hour.
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: Someone requested a password reset for your Harly account. Use the button below to choose a new password.
reset.notice: If you didn't request this, please ignore this email. Your password won't change until you access the link above and create a new one.

verify.subject: Verify your email
verify.preview: One click and you're in — verify your Harly email.
verify.heading: Verify your email
verify.body: Click the button below to confirm your address and finish setting up your account. This link expires in 24 hours.
verify.notice: Didn't sign up for Harly? You can safely ignore this email.

portalMagic.subject: Your sign-in link
portalMagic.preview: Your sign-in link is ready — expires in 15 minutes.
portalMagic.heading: Sign in to your portal
portalMagic.body: Click below to sign in. This link works once and expires in 15 minutes.

staffMagic.subject: Sign in to Harly
staffMagic.body: Click below to sign in. If you did not request this, you can safely ignore this email.

portalReset.subject: Reset your portal password
portalReset.preview: Reset your portal password — the link expires in 1 hour.
portalReset.heading: Reset your password
portalReset.body: Click below to choose a new password. This link works once and expires in 1 hour.
portalReset.notice: Didn't request this? You can safely ignore it. Your password has not changed.

welcome.subject: Welcome to Harly
welcome.heading: Welcome, {name}
welcome.body: Your {workspace} workspace is ready. Post your first job, publish it to your career page, and start tracking candidates — all in one place.

invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {workspace}
invitation.heading: You're invited to {workspace}
invitation.body: {inviter} has added you to {workspace} as a {role}. Click below to accept and set up your account.
invitation.notice: This invitation expires in 7 days. Not expecting this? You can safely ignore it.

rejection.subject: Your application for {job} at {company}
rejection.preview: An update on your application for {job} at {company}.
rejection.heading: Update on your application
rejection.body: Thank you for applying to {job} at {company}. After careful consideration, we've decided to move forward with other candidates.

stageUpdate.subject: You're moving to {stage} — {job}
stageUpdate.preview: Good news — your {job} application has moved to {stage}.
stageUpdate.heading: You're moving forward
stageUpdate.body: Your application for {job} at {company} has moved to the {stage} stage.
stageUpdate.next: Someone from the team will reach out shortly with next steps.

applicationCandidate.subject: Got your application — {job} at {company}
applicationCandidate.preview: Your application for {job} is in. We'll be in touch.
applicationCandidate.heading: Application received
applicationCandidate.body: We got your application for {job}. The team will review it carefully and reach out if there's a fit.
applicationCandidate.thanks: Thanks for taking the time — we appreciate it.

offer.subject: Offer from {company} — {job}
offer.preview: {company} wants you on the team. Here's your offer.
offer.heading: You have an offer
offer.body: We'd love to have you join {company} as {job}. Here's what we're offering:
offer.outro: Review the offer using the link above, or reply to this email with any questions. We're excited to hear from you.

offerWithdrawn.subject: Update on your offer — {job} at {company}
offerWithdrawn.preview: An update on your offer for {job} at {company}.
offerWithdrawn.heading: Offer update
offerWithdrawn.body: The offer for {job} at {company} has been withdrawn.
offerWithdrawn.questions: Questions? Reply to this email and we'll walk you through what happened.

interviewCanceled.subject: Interview canceled — {job} at {company}
interviewCanceled.heading: Interview canceled
interviewCanceled.body: Your {type} for {job} has been canceled. We’re sorry for the inconvenience.
interviewCanceled.bodyWithTime: Your {type} for {job} scheduled for {when} has been canceled. We’re sorry for the inconvenience.
interviewCanceled.reschedule: Reply to this email and we'll find a new time that works.

interviewScheduled.subject: Interview confirmed — {job} at {company}
interviewScheduled.heading: Interview confirmed
interviewScheduled.body: Hi {name}, your {type} for {job} at {company} is on the calendar.
interviewScheduled.outro: Need to reschedule? Just reply to this email.

interviewRescheduled.subject: Interview rescheduled — {job} at {company}
interviewRescheduled.heading: Interview rescheduled
interviewRescheduled.body: Hi {name}, your {type} for {job} at {company} has a new time:
interviewRescheduled.outro: Need to adjust again? Just reply to this email.

signatureInvitation.subject: {company} asked you to sign {document}
signatureInvitation.preview: {company} is waiting for your signature on {document}.
signatureInvitation.heading: Please review and sign
signatureInvitation.body: {company} has asked you to review and sign a document.
signatureInvitation.reminderBody: This is a friendly reminder that {company} is still waiting for your signature.
signatureInvitation.notice: This link is personal to you. Do not forward it. If you were not expecting this request, you can ignore this email or reply to ask the sender.
